throughline.zh: 11 月 13 日台灣業者陸續披露先進封裝產線與廠區建設、伺服器財報、製程感測採購，以及工廠供電和工業電腦專案。
throughline.en: Taiwanese firms disclosed advanced-packaging production and construction plans, server results, process-sensing purchases, factory power projects and rugged computing contracts on November 13.

title.zh: 晶圓、先進封裝產線與廠區擴建
title.en: Wafer and advanced-packaging production and facilities

summary.zh: 精材與台積電簽訂先進封裝 oS 模組產能外包協議，首期量產規劃 2029 年。日月光路竹廠一期啟用、二期動土，千億元總投資與未來年營收均屬公司滿載後估計。
summary.en: Xintec signed an outsourcing agreement for TSMC's on-substrate packaging, targeting initial production in 2029. ASE opened Luzhu phase one and started phase two; investment and revenue figures refer to estimated full buildout.

title.zh: 伺服器營收與跨區產能規劃

summary.zh: 技嘉公布第三季合併營收與前九月伺服器占比，並提及台灣、美國及馬來西亞擴廠計畫。公開資料沒有單獨列出新山新增機櫃產能。
summary.en: Gigabyte reported Q3 group revenue, a nine-month server sales mix and expansion plans across Taiwan, the United States and Malaysia. No additional Johor rack capacity was separately disclosed.

title.zh: 半導體產值統計與未來預測

summary.zh: 台灣半導體產業協會發布工研院第三季產值統計，涵蓋晶圓代工、記憶體、封裝與測試。全年 9.762 兆元為研究機構預估，並非已實現營收。
summary.en: TSIA published ITRI's Q3 output data across foundries, memory, packaging and testing. The NT$9.762tn annual estimate is a forecast, not realized annual revenue.

title.zh: 製程化學感測與工廠電力管理
title.en: Chemical sensing and factory power management

summary.zh: Ainos 公布日月光新增 5,000 台化學感測設備採購；聚恆與燿華另啟動宜蘭廠 5.04MW 表後儲能建置。前者有簽訂採購合約，後者仍在工程階段，尚未公布運轉實績。
summary.en: Ainos announced an additional 5,000 chemical sensors ordered by ASE, while Juheng and Unitech began a 5.04MW battery project at a Yilan factory. The former is a procurement contract and the latter a construction project without operating data.

title.zh: 製造場址交易與強固型工業電腦
title.en: Manufacturing property and rugged industrial computers

summary.zh: 華紙通過向元太出售觀音廠，交易價 27.8 億元，尚未揭露新增材料產能。神基另揭露兩筆歐美無人載具地面控制相關訂單，客戶與出貨數量未公布。
summary.en: Chung Hwa Pulp approved a NT$2.78bn Guanyin property sale to E Ink without a new materials-capacity figure. Getac also disclosed two US and European unmanned-system ground-control projects without customer names or unit commitments.
